instructions: Squeeze 1 tablespoon of juice from the lemon into a large salad bowl. Whisk in the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Add the arugula and toss until every leaf is lightly coated.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave about 1/2 cup of shavings from the Parmesan wedge.
Scatter the shavings over the salad, toss gently and serve right away.
method_notes: Once Upon a Chef (the lead, 5.0 from 35) whisks a plain lemon and olive oil dressing in the bowl, tosses the arugula in it and finishes with shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano. Tyler Florence uses the same three parts with a bit more oil and tastes before the cheese goes on. I follow the lead's ratio of 3 parts oil to 1 part lemon. Shave the cheese from a wedge, since pre-grated doesn't melt into the leaves the same way.
